title: Bonds Improve Post Mission Disposal Compliance and the Sustainability of Low Earth Orbit
abstract: Post-mission disposal (PMD) non-compliance is a major threat to the long-term sustainability of Low Earth Orbit (LEO). From 2010–2024, only 40% of satellites in non-naturally compliant orbits successfully deorbited. With launch rates rising rapidly and large constellations expanding the active population, reducing the number of long-lived derelicts is increasingly urgent. We evaluate an escrow-based PMD performance bond on satellite operators, designed to increase disposal compliance by making non-compliance financially costly while preserving access to orbit. The analysis uses an integrated assessment framework that couples an economic decision-making model for satellite operators with a model for the evolution of the space object populations in LEO, enabling launch decisions and debris risk to co-evolve endogenously over a 25-year horizon. Results show that bonds of $200k per satellite can reduce the mass of derelict satellite per year by more than one-third and increase welfare by up to 27%. Bonds greater than $1 million exhibit diminishing marginal returns. We also examine partial bond adoption and market leakage and find that a bond that only covers 20% of the global market can still achieve meaningful derelict reductions and space sustainability improvements. Broader participation improves both environmental and economic welfare outcomes.
abstract_zh: 训练后处置（PMD）不合规是对近地轨道（LEO）长期可持续性的重大威胁。2010–2024年间，处于非自然合规轨道的卫星中仅有40%成功离轨。随着发射率快速上升，以及大型星座扩大在轨活跃卫星数量，减少长寿命遗留空间物体的数量日益紧迫。我们评估了一种针对卫星运营商的、基于托管账户的PMD履约保证金制度，其设计目标是通过使不合规行为付出经济代价来提高处置合规率，同时保留运营商进入轨道的机会。分析采用综合评估框架，将卫星运营商的经济决策模型与近地轨道空间物体种群演化模型耦合，使发射决策与碰撞风险在25年的时间跨度内内生地共同演化。结果显示，每颗卫星20万美元的保证金可使每年遗留卫星的质量减少三分之一以上，并使福利提高至多27%。超过100万美元的保证金边际收益递减。我们还考察了保证金的部分采用与市场泄漏问题，发现仅覆盖全球市场20%的保证金仍可实现可观的遗留物削减和空间可持续性改善。更广泛的参与则同时改善环境与经济福利结果。

title: Spatio-temporal heterogeneity in the environmental value of renewable energy
abstract:
The expansion of renewable energy plays a critical role in decarbonizing the electricity grid, while also providing improvements in local air quality. Ultimately, the environmental value of renewable energy hinges on characteristics (fuel type, technology, location, etc.) of the marginal plant displaced by wind or solar generation. We document and explain the roles that market forces, policy interactions, and energy infrastructure play in determining the displaced marginal generator, and thus the heterogeneous environmental value of renewables. Finally, we discuss how this heterogeneity in environmental value significantly complicates efficient regulatory approaches, with application to renewable production subsidies and green hydrogen policies.

abstract_zh:
可再生能源的扩张在电网脱碳中发挥着关键作用，同时还能改善当地空气质量。归根结底，可再生能源的环境价值取决于被风电或太阳能发电替代的边际电厂的特征（燃料类型、技术、位置等）。我们揭示并解释了市场力量、政策互动和能源基础设施在决定被替代的边际发电机组中所起的作用，从而阐明了可再生能源环境价值的异质性。最后，我们讨论了这种环境价值的异质性如何显著增加有效监管方法的复杂性，并以可再生能源生产补贴和绿氢政策为例加以说明。

title: Travel Choices under Pandemic Federalism
Are renewable generators price responsive?
Decarbonization and electricity price vulnerability
abstract:
Many countries in Europe have substantially increased their share of
carbon-free electricity over the past decades. However, the dramatic
2021-2022 increase in European natural gas prices and electricity prices
has raised concerns about the vulnerability of electricity markets. Here,
we develop a country-specific metric of vulnerability and find that
countries that pursued more aggressive electricity decarbonization are
not more vulnerable to natural gas price shocks. However, countries
with a higher share of intermittent renewable generation are slightly
more vulnerable, potentially due to the complementarity of these technologies
with natural gas generation. We show that heterogeneity in
vulnerability implies country-specific policies are required to avoid unintended
climate consequences of extreme electricity prices, in contrast
to the existing uniform EU price cap. Our results emphasize that
decarbonization goals can still be achieved without risking vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 过去几十年间，欧洲许多国家大幅提高了无碳电力的占比。然而，2021至2022年间欧洲天然气价格和电价的急剧上涨，引发了人们对电力市场脆弱性的担忧。在此，我们构建了一个针对各国的脆弱性指标，发现那些更为积极推进电力脱碳的国家，并不更容易受到天然气价格冲击的影响。然而，间歇性可再生能源发电占比较高的国家则略微更为脆弱，这可能是由于这些技术与天然气发电之间存在互补性。我们表明，脆弱性的异质性意味着需要因国而异的政策，以避免极端电价带来意想不到的气候后果，这与现行统一的欧盟电价上限形成对比。我们的结果表明，脱碳目标无需以脆弱性为代价即可实现。

Decline in Traffic Congestion Increased Crash Severity in the Wake of COVID-19
abstract: Highway fatalities are a leading cause of death in the U.S. and other industrialized countries. Using highly detailed crash, speed, and flow data, we show highway travel and motor vehicle crashes fell substantially in California during the response to the COVID-19 pandemic. However, we also show the frequency of severe crashes increased owing to lower traffic congestion and higher highway speeds. This “speed effect” is largest in counties with high pre-existing levels of congestion, and we show it partially or completely offsets the “VMT effect” of reduced vehicle miles traveled on total fatalities. During the first eleven weeks of the COVID-19 response, highway driving decreased by approximately 22% and total crashes decreased by 49%. While average speeds increased by a modest 2 to 3 mph across the state, they increased between 10 and 15 mph in several counties. The proportion of severe crashes increased nearly 5 percentage points, or 25%. While fatalities decreased initially following restrictions, increased speeds mitigated the effect of lower vehicle miles traveled on fatalities, yielding little to no reduction in fatalities later in the COVID period.
abstract_zh: 公路交通死亡是美国及其他工业化国家的主要死因之一。利用高度细化的事故、车速和车流数据，我们发现，在应对COVID-19大流行期间，加州的公路出行量和机动车事故显著减少。然而，我们也发现，由于交通拥堵减轻和公路车速提高，严重事故的发生频率反而上升。这种“车速效应”在事前拥堵水平较高的县最为显著，并且我们发现它部分或完全抵消了行驶里程减少（“VMT效应”）对总死亡人数的影响。在COVID-19应对措施实施的前十一周内，公路驾驶量下降约22%，事故总数下降49%。尽管全州平均车速仅提高了2至3英里/小时，但在若干县车速提高了10至15英里/小时。严重事故占比上升了近5个百分点，即增长25%。限制措施实施之初死亡人数有所下降，但车速提高抵消了行驶里程减少对死亡人数的影响，导致疫情后期死亡人数几乎没有下降。

title: Disease-economy trade-offs under alternative pandemic control strategies
Emissions, transmission, and the environmental value of renewable energy
abstract: We examine how transmission congestion alters the environmental benefits provided by renewable generation. Using hourly data from the Texas and midcontinent electricity markets, we find that relaxing transmission constraints between the wind-rich areas and the demand centers of the respective markets conservatively increases the nonmarket value of wind by 30 percent for Texas and 17 percent for midcontinent markets. Much of this increase in the nonmarket value arises from a redistribution in where air quality improvements occur—when transmission is not constrained, wind offsets much more pollution from fossil fuel units located near highly populated demand centers. (JEL L94, Q42, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 本文考察输电阻塞如何改变可再生能源发电所带来的环境效益。利用得克萨斯州和中部大陆（Midcontinent）电力市场的逐时数据，我们发现，放宽风能丰富地区与各市场负荷中心之间的输电约束，可保守地使风电的非市场价值在得克萨斯州提高30%，在中部大陆市场提高17%。非市场价值增长的很大一部分源于空气质量改善发生地点的重新分布：当输电不受约束时，风电能够抵消更多位于人口密集负荷中心附近的化石燃料机组所排放的污染。（JEL L94, Q42, Q51, Q53）

Intermittency and CO2 reductions from wind energy
abstract: Using detailed 5-minute electricity generation data, we examine the impact of wind intermittency on carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions savings from wind energy in the Southwest Power Pool from 2012-2014. Parametric and semi-parametric analysis confirms concerns that intra-hour wind intermittency reduces CO2 emissions savings from wind—in the top decile of wind intermittency, emission savings are reduced by nearly 10 percent. However, the average wind intermittency effect on emission savings is modest, on the order of 6.5 percent when accounting for dynamic effects. Evidence suggests the intermittency effect is likely to remain modest in the near-term.
abstract_zh: 利用精细的5分钟发电数据，我们考察了2012–2014年西南电力联盟（Southwest Power Pool）中风电间歇性对风能二氧化碳（CO2）减排效益的影响。参数与半参数分析证实了一种担忧：小时内的风电间歇性会降低风能的减排效益，在风电间歇性最强的十分位组中，减排量减少了近10%。然而，考虑动态效应后，风电间歇性对减排效益的平均影响较为温和，约为6.5%。证据表明，在近期内该间歇性效应可能仍将保持在较小水平。

title: Optimal environmental border adjustments under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
abstract: A country’s optimal environmental border policy includes a strategic component that is inconsistent with commitments under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). We extend the theory to include GATT compliance. Theory supports optimal border adjustments on carbon content that are below the domestic carbon price, because price signals sent through border adjustments encourage consumption of emissions intensive goods in unregulated regions. The theory is supported in our applied numeric simulations. Countries imposing border adjustments at the domestic carbon price will be extracting rents from unregulated regions at the expense of efficient environmental policy and consistency with international trade law.
abstract_zh: 一国最优的环境边境政策包含一个战略性成分，而这一成分与其在《关税与贸易总协定》（GATT）下的承诺并不一致。我们将理论扩展至纳入GATT合规约束。理论表明，最优的基于碳含量的边境调节应低于国内碳价，因为通过边境调节传递的价格信号会鼓励未受监管地区增加排放密集型商品的消费。我们的应用数值模拟支持了这一理论。若各国按国内碳价实施边境调节，则将以牺牲有效环境政策和国际贸易法的一致性为代价，从未受监管地区攫取租金。

The fall of coal: Joint impacts of fuel prices and renewables on generation and emissions
abstract: Since 2007, US coal-fired electricity generation has declined by a stunning 25 percent. Detailed daily unit-level data is used to examine the joint impact of natural gas prices and wind generation on coal-fired generation and emissions, with a focus on the interaction between gas prices and wind. This interaction is found to be significant. Marginal responses of coal-fired generation to natural gas prices (wind) in 2013 were larger, sometimes much larger, than the counterfactual with 2008 wind generation (gas prices). Additionally, these factors jointly account for the vast majority of the observed decline in generation and emissions. (JEL L94, L95, Q35, Q38, Q42, Q53)
abstract_zh: 自2007年以来，美国燃煤发电量已惊人地下降了25%。我们利用逐日机组层面的详细数据，考察天然气价格与风力发电对燃煤发电及排放的联合影响，重点关注天然气价格与风电之间的交互作用。研究发现，这一交互作用十分显著。2013年燃煤发电量对天然气价格（风电）的边际响应，大于以2008年风电水平（天然气价格）为反事实情形下的响应，有时甚至大得多。此外，这些因素共同解释了所观察到的发电量和排放下降的绝大部分。（JEL L94, L95, Q35, Q38, Q42, Q53）

abstract: This study examines the effect of waste and recycling policy on scrap prices and the importance of scrap price feedbacks as a determinant of policy costs. Price effects and direct and indirect channels of waste reduction are decomposed for deposit/refund, advance disposal fee, and recycling subsidies. Scrap price feedbacks decrease the cost of advance disposal fees, increase the cost of recycling subsidies, and have an ambiguous effect on the cost of deposit/refund. Simulation analysis finds that scrap price feedbacks substantially affect the costs of the policies and alter the ranking of instruments. (JEL Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本研究考察废弃物与回收政策对废料价格的影响，以及废料价格反馈作为政策成本决定因素的重要性。我们将押金退还、预付处置费和回收补贴的价格效应，以及废物减量的直接与间接渠道进行了分解。废料价格反馈降低了预付处置费的成本，提高了回收补贴的成本，并对押金退还的成本产生方向不明确的影响。模拟分析表明，废料价格反馈显著影响各项政策的成本，并改变了各政策工具的排序。（JEL Q53, Q58）

Emissions savings from wind power generation in Texas
abstract: Wind power has the potential to reduce emissions associated with conventional electricity generation. Using detailed, systemic hourly data of wind generation and emissions from plants in ERCOT (Texas), we empirically estimate the SO2, NOx and CO2 emissions offset by wind generation. Our estimation strategy implicitly captures both the marginal unit of generation displaced by wind on the electrical grid, and the marginal emissions reduction from that displaced unit. Our results also reveal substantial variation in emissions reductions, which appear to be strongly driven by differences in the generation mix. The environmental benefits from emissions reductions in ERCOT fail to cover government subsidies for wind generation.
abstract_zh: 风电有潜力减少与传统发电相关的排放。利用ERCOT（得克萨斯州）风力发电及电厂排放的详细、系统性逐时数据，我们实证估计了风力发电所抵消的SO2、NOx和CO2排放量。我们的估计策略隐含地同时捕捉了风电在电网中替代的边际发电单元，以及该被替代单元的边际减排量。我们的结果还揭示了减排量存在显著差异，这种差异似乎主要由发电结构的差异所驱动。ERCOT地区的减排环境效益不足以抵补政府对风电的补贴。

abstract: Spatial connectivity of renewable resources induces a spatial externality in extraction. We explore the consequences of decentralized spatial property rights in the presence of spatial externalities. We generalize the notion of unitization -developed to enhance cooperative extraction of oil and gas fields -and apply it to renewable resources which face a similar spatial commons problem. We find that unitizing a common pool renewable resource can yield first-best outcomes even when participation is voluntary, provided profit sharing rules can vary by participant.
abstract_zh: 可再生资源的空间连通性会在开采中引发空间外部性。我们探讨了在存在空间外部性的情况下，去中心化空间产权的后果。我们推广了为提高石油和天然气田合作开采效率而发展起来的“统一开发”（unitization）概念，并将其应用于面临类似空间公地问题的可再生资源。我们发现，即使参与是自愿的，只要利润分配规则可以因参与者而异，统一开发共同池可再生资源就能够实现第一最优结果。

title: Implications of agricultural policy for species invasion in shifting cultivation systems
abstract: Policies to influence land use decisions in agriculture or grazing can increase the ability of invasive species to out-compete native species and thereby disrupt seemingly stable ecological-economic systems. Building off of models of interdependent resources, invasive species and soil fertility, this paper develops a model of shifting cultivation decisions for two types of farmers, one who sees the threat of invasive grasses and one who does not. The paper uses numerical solutions to this dynamic decision problem to examine the impact of various policies on farmer welfare and on the stability of the economic-ecological system. Some policies undermine the resilience of the system, while other policies augment the system's ability to withstand species invasions.
abstract_zh: 影响农业或放牧土地利用决策的政策，可能增强入侵物种相对于本地物种的竞争能力，从而扰乱看似稳定的生态-经济系统。基于相互依存的资源、入侵物种与土壤肥力模型，本文构建了针对两类农民的轮作耕作（shifting cultivation）决策模型：一类农民察觉到入侵草本的威胁，另一类则没有。本文利用该动态决策问题的数值解，考察各类政策对农民福利及经济-生态系统稳定性的影响。某些政策会削弱系统的韧性，而另一些政策则增强了系统抵御物种入侵的能力。
